body: I grab a plunger from the shelf and hold it by the open oven doors, my eyes narrowing as I take in the scene. The heat from the ovens makes my skin prickle with discomfort. My mind starts racing with questions. Why is this happening? Who could be so careless? I take a deep breath, mentally preparing myself for the confrontation ahead.
